text_block_list.text:
"—Their live performance came to an end, 
and the stage set was completely 
dismantled."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bourbon-san! Today's live was so cool 
too!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um... it was truly wonderful... I feel 
like I want to try working even harder 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Because it reached me... Bourbon-san's 
feelings, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I could feel her sheer desire to "do her 
best" coming through loud and clear...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list:
Your feelings are coming through loud and 
clear.

Your feelings are coming through loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-chan, your performance today was 
truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of trick did you figure 
out!? Teach Falco, teach me, please!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I put my desire to “tell her” into action.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With the goal of pouring real emotion into 
it. Just like the live performance by 
Falcon-san I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Did I 'achieve' it too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! You did it! You totally, suuuper 
pulled it off!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, Fal-Fal Gauge UP! And so, 
Bourbon-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All my joy and all my gratitude! I'm gonna 
deliver it all straight to the fans~☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Besides recruiting collaborators, the 
concert also seems to be fostering growth 
in each of the Umamusume.

While rejoicing at how well they were 
doing, I began planning for the next step, 
when...

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you hear about the Grand 
Live project!? Can we join in too!?

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I want to try singing! I 
wonder if we can sing "NEXT FRONTIER" and 
stuff? It's always been my dream!!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...A concert that anyone can participate 
in? Are you really okay with that...?"

—A chorus of voices began to ring out from 
all around the venue.
